text: Or, a vine emptying the fruite which it giueth. , Heb. statues, or standing images.
Or, he hath diuided their heart. , Heb. behead.
Heb. the face of the water.
Or, when I shall bind them for their two transgressions, or in their two habitations.
Heb. the beautie of her necke.
Hebr. the euill of your euill.
